forum.title: STM ADC Single vs Differential Ended Channels
forum.best_answer_content: For the 563, calibrate twice, once single ended, then again differential. The appropriate cal factor is then automatically applied. Read the 563 reference manual on the subject. See if the 491 reference manual covers the subject.
forum.content_text: I use H563 and G491 MCUs. There is HAL\_ADCEx\_Calibration\_Start() on both MCUs to calibrate for single or differential ended inputs. If I have mixed single and differential ended inputs on the same ADC, which do I use? Single or differential?
forum.author: mccabehm
